document: Idaho Deed of Trust - Single Family - Fannie Mae/Freddie Mac Uniform Instrument, Form 3013 (FHA case)
form_reference: Fannie Mae Form 3013 Idaho standard form. Security instruments: https://singlefamily.fanniemae.com/legal-docs
legal_description: Lot 14, Block 3 of the Payette River Bridge Subdivision Phase II, according to the official plat thereof, filed in Book 94 of Plats at Pages 43 through 45, records of Ada County, Idaho.
transfer_of_rights_in_the_property: This Security Instrument secures to Lender the repayment of the Loan and the performance of Borrower's covenants. Borrower irrevocably grants and conveys to Trustee, in trust, with power of sale, the property described above. The Note or a partial interest in the Note, together with this Security Instrument, may be sold or otherwise transferred one or more times, and Loan Servicer may change, without rewriting this instrument.
